final: WITH s AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.CPK*1.0/l.GPT) AS a FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID=l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), o1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM s), k1 AS (SELECT s.sex, s.a, s.a-o1.v AS d1 FROM s JOIN o1 ON o1.v IS NOT NULL WHERE s.a>o1.v), o2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a, k1.d1, k1.a-o2.v AS d2 FROM k1 JOIN o2 ON o2.v IS NOT NULL WHERE k1.a>o2.v) SELECT AVG(a), AVG(d1), AVG(d2) FROM k2
